theory.intro: Angles are named by their size. Knowing the special turns lets you classify any angle on sight.
steps: Compare the angle with the right angle ($90^{\circ}$) and the straight angle ($180^{\circ}$).
Decide which range it falls in.
Name it: acute, right, obtuse, straight, reflex or revolution.

foundation.solution_text: The marked angle is greater than $0^{\circ}$ and less than $90^{\circ}$, so it is an acute angle.
The square mark shows $90^{\circ}$, so it is a right angle.
The marked angle is greater than $90^{\circ}$ and less than $180^{\circ}$, so it is obtuse.
An angle of exactly $180^{\circ}$ is a straight angle.
$240^{\circ}$ is between $180^{\circ}$ and $360^{\circ}$, so it is reflex.
An angle of exactly $360^{\circ}$ is a revolution, or full turn.

development.solution_text: $91^{\circ}$ is just above $90^{\circ}$ and below $180^{\circ}$, so it is obtuse.
$179^{\circ}$ is below $180^{\circ}$ but above $90^{\circ}$, so it is obtuse.
$181^{\circ}$ is above $180^{\circ}$ but below $360^{\circ}$, so it is reflex.
$290^{\circ}$ is between $180^{\circ}$ and $360^{\circ}$, so it is reflex.

development.question_text:
A rectangle corner has an outside angle of $270^{\circ}$.
Classify that outside angle.
development.solution_text: $270^{\circ}$ is between $180^{\circ}$ and $360^{\circ}$, so it is reflex.

mastery.solution_text: $45^{\circ}$ acute; $90^{\circ}$ right; $135^{\circ}$ obtuse; $180^{\circ}$ straight; $315^{\circ}$ reflex; $360^{\circ}$ revolution.

mastery.question_text: Which of these angles is the smallest obtuse angle: $112^{\circ}$, $92^{\circ}$, $32^{\circ}$, $88^{\circ}$, $178^{\circ}$?
mastery.solution_text: The obtuse angles are $112^{\circ}$, $92^{\circ}$ and $178^{\circ}$. The smallest obtuse angle is $92^{\circ}$.

mastery.question_text: Which of these angles is the largest acute angle: $108^{\circ}$, $94^{\circ}$, $28^{\circ}$, $87^{\circ}$, $176^{\circ}$?
mastery.solution_text: The acute angles are $28^{\circ}$ and $87^{\circ}$. The largest acute angle is $87^{\circ}$.
